item.marvel_zombie.mjolnir.tooltip.charg: Use Charge Storm to fill your energy and unlock charged abilities
item.marvel_zombie.mjolnir.tooltip.throw: Sneak + left-click: throw and recall Mjölnir
item.marvel_zombie.mjolnir.tooltip.recal: Sneak + left-click while empty-handed: recall Mjölnir
item.marvel_zombie.smoke_bomb.tooltip: Right-click to spread calming smoke; no damage
item.marvel_zombie.sling_ring.tooltip: Hold the ring and use its Palladium ability to choose the portal destination.
advancement.x.worthy.description: Wield Mjölnir for the first time.
ability.marvel_zombie.mjolnir_recall.des: Call your bound Mjölnir back while your hands are empty.
ability.marvel_zombie.charge_storm.descr: Press to fully charge your energy. You cannot move for 1 second; 120-second cooldown.
ability.marvel_zombie.mjolnir_spin.descr: While uncharged, hold to spin Mjölnir, damage and knock mobs away. Lasts up to 5 seconds.
ability.marvel_zombie.thunder_bolt.descr: While charged, hold to fire a visible lightning beam that consumes energy.
ability.marvel_zombie.storm_slam.descrip: While charged, press on the ground to leap and deal doubled area damage with lightning on landing.
ability.marvel_zombie.open_portal.descri: Use to open a linked portal pair at chosen coordinates.
gui.marvel_zombie.sling_ring.title: Sling Ring
message.marvel_zombie.sling_ring.invalid: Invalid coordinates or outside the world border.
message.marvel_zombie.sling_ring.unsafe_: There is no safe spot near those coordinates. Choose a point with solid ground and clear space.
message.marvel_zombie.sling_ring.opened: The linked portals will remain open for 1 minute.
